description: List what changed since a date, newest first: catalog entries added or re-verified, first audits of hosted MCP servers, and a summary of the latest audit run. Dates come from catalog history and audit records, never the build time. Omit since for the latest events. Save next_since and pass it as since on your next call. The same list is published as JSON at /changes.json (?since=) and as Atom at /changes.xml. Default 200, max 1000.

since.description: Only events strictly newer than this ISO date or datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or full timestamp)

name: get_changes
title: What's changed
